topic: be proud of how far you've come
lines: #Before this week ends, I want you to look *back.*
#A year ago, you were fighting battles you've already *won.*
Problems that kept you awake are *behind* you now.
You survived days you thought would *break* you.
Maybe you didn't hit every goal this *week.*
We're so busy chasing the next goal, we never *celebrate.*
Write down three things you did *right* this week.
#The person you were would be *proud* of you.
Now rest. Next week, we go *again.*
end: Send this to someone who's come a long way.

post.title: Before This Week Ends, Look How Far You Came
post.caption: You survived days you thought would break you. Be proud. 🌅
post.first_comment: Name one thing you're proud of this week 👇
